Welcome to Crazy K Farm! 🐔🐱🦆

We're a Texas-based animal sanctuary AND the makers of award-winning pet products trusted by 50,000+ pet owners worldwide

🏡 OUR SANCTUARY (501c3 Nonprofit - EIN 46-2942130)
Caring for 200+ rescued animals including chickens, ducks, geese, cats, dogs, horses, goats, sheep, pigs & parrots in Hempstead, Texas. Featured on CBS Sunday Morning & Animal Planet.

🛒 OUR PRODUCTS (Made in USA)
• Kitty Holster® - #1 rated cat walking harness
• Hen Saver® - Chicken saddles & protection
• Hen Holster® - Bird diapers for chickens, ducks & geese  
• Birdy Bootie® - Bumblefoot treatment & foot protection
• Diapurr® - Cat diapers for special needs cats

Every purchase supports rescued animals! 🐾

📺 Watch how-to videos, animal rescue stories & product tutorials
🎓 20+ patents | Featured on CBS, in Houston Chronicle & Backyard Poultry
👩‍🔬 Founded by Dr. Tobi Kosanke, Ph.D. Geologist turned entrepreneur

#CrazyKFarm #AnimalRescue #BackyardChickens #CatHarness #MadeInUSA
